description: PARTIAL DISCHARGE-Phase 2B only: Details submitted pursuant to reference 24/02608/FUL for Flood Management Plan  (41) in respect of the demolition of 11no. existing residential blocks and 4 dwellings and associated structures and construction of residential and mixed-use buildings providing ground floor flexible commercial floorspace (Use Class E(a, b, c and e)), residential dwellings (Use Class C3) along with associated road layout, car and cycle parking, hard and soft landscaping, amenity space, public, communal and private realm and associated works. (An Environmental Statement, including a non-technical summary, also accompanies the planning application in accordance with the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017 (as amended)).
decision_conditions: The details submitted is sufficient to satisfy the discharge of Flood Management Plan condition (41) of permission ref: 24/02608/FUL and accordingly shall be approved.
